purpose: Medir calidad y consumo total de una política selectiva de Graphtyn frente a lectura local en modIAceb.

design.order: Within each client: paired AB/BA, reversing task order in repetition 2. Preserve all attempted cells.
design.model_control: Use the same underlying model and fixed reasoning effort across clients only if all three expose the exact same model revision and settings. Otherwise treat client+model as an experimental environment, report each separately, and do not pool token totals or infer a client-only effect.
design.selective_policy: Use graph_query_intent once; expand or read bounded source when obligations remain missing. Do not require project memory for code-only tasks. Validate only material claims.
design.grading: Frozen six-obligation rubric per task; blind independent grading when available. Preserve every run and failure.

mcp_contract.implementation: One Graphtyn MCP implementation shared by all clients; do not create three product variants.
mcp_contract.session_isolation: Each benchmark session may launch its own stdio server process.

client_configuration.opencode: Project-local OpenCode MCP entry plus an OpenCode event adapter.
client_configuration.codex: .codex/config.toml MCP entry plus a Codex JSON-event adapter.
client_configuration.antigravity: .agents/mcp_config.json MCP entry plus an Antigravity stream-event adapter. The legacy CLI query-intent runner is not equivalent to MCP use.

phase_1.scope: One frozen task, both arms, one repetition, all three clients

phase_2.scope: C1-C3, both arms, two repetitions, all three clients

success_rule: Comparable quality with lower tokens or time, or a prespecified quality gain that justifies higher consumption.
notes: The ceilings are proposals, not authorization.
Do not start phase 1 until the three adapters expose comparable usage fields and the user approves token and monetary ceilings.
Do not rerun successful cells to select favorable answers.
